s.0: Shows when this product is part of a mix & match bundle. Needs the Bundle tray app embed on. Words and look: CRO Toolbox → Bundles → Design.
s.1: Steps, products and the look are set in CRO Toolbox → Bundles. Shoppers pay the bundle product's price, and each picked item's stock goes down.
s.2: Lets shoppers build your mix & match bundles anywhere: Add to bundle on product pages, + buttons on collection pages and a tray that follows them. Set it up in the app: Bundles.
s.3: Shows Cross-sell rules that have "Cart drawer" ticked, inside your theme's slide-out cart. Works with Dawn and themes built on it. Heading, products and button are set in CRO Toolbox → Cross-sell offers → Design.
s.4: Products, headline and discount come from your Cross-sell rules; the look is set in CRO Toolbox → Cross-sell offers → Design.
s.5: Offers come from your Upsell rules in CRO Toolbox; their look and wording are set in the app: Upsell offers → Design.
s.6: Videos, their order and linked products, the look and the pages it shows on are all set in CRO Toolbox → Video carousel.
s.7: Place it under the Add to cart button. Add-ons, texts and colours are set in the app: Offers → Add-ons.
s.8: Messages, icons, dates and the look are set in the app: Store sections → Announcements.
s.9: Sticky add to cart, stock urgency, trust badges, sales pop-ups and bundle deals. Edit them in the app: Boosters and Bundles.
s.14: Put the text on a box
s.a: Collections, order, colours and sizes are set in the app: Store sections → Collection pills.
s.b: Fields, texts, colours and sizes are designed in the app: Pages → Contact page.
s.c: Place it in the Header or Footer area, on the home page or on product pages. Each place has its own design, set in the app: Countdown timers.
s.d: Questions and the look are set in the app: Store sections → FAQ. Here you only choose what this copy shows.
s.f: Optional, e.g. Shipping. Empty = all questions.
s.h: Optional. Empty = the heading set in the app.
s.i: Help Google show these questions in search
s.j: Adds FAQ structured data. Use it on one page only.
s.k: Keep it in the Header area. Layout, logo, menu, icons, colours and glass effects are set in the app: Headers and footers → Header. The menu comes from Online Store → Navigation.
s.o: Tall image, about 1000 × 1250 px. Empty = the desktop image.
s.1d: When scrolled to (lower on the page)
s.1h: Images, texts, sizes and arrows are set in the app: Store sections → Image carousel.
s.1i: Logos, their order and the look are set in the app: Store sections → Logos.
s.1j: Adds a button to every product card; products with sizes or colours open a small picker. The look is set in the app: Boosters → Quick add.
s.1k: Reviews and how they look are set in the app: Store sections → Customer reviews.
s.1l: Goal, messages, colours and where it shows are set in the app: Boosters → Free shipping bar.
